paper.title: Superconductivity in the $t$-$t'$ Hubbard Model from Symmetry-Preserving Neural-Network Quantum States
paper.authors: Riccardo Rende, Luciano Loris Viteritti, Antoine Georges

results.system_description: 12x12 square lattice, periodic in both directions; U/t = 8, t'/t = -0.2; 126 electrons (63 up, 63 down), 1/8 hole doping
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational energy of the symmetry-preserving SBP state on the periodic L × L cluster at t' = -0.2, U = 8, 1/8 doping; the Transformer, HFPS, Tensor-Backflow and ACE rows are quoted comparisons and excluded.
results.notes: Transcribed from the cited location of the versioned arXiv source and checked against the printed token; curator review pending. Parenthesized uncertainties are recorded as reported, with their meaning left unspecified unless the paper states it.
